subject: prd/forgejo-feature-draft
statement: Fresh installed Forgejo flow opens, iterates, prepares, and identifies one native PR without gh; separate abandonment fixtures preserve the required policy, reason, human review, and transition.
fit_criterion: Transcript with status/open/round/rebase, PR/head/digest, normal hook outcomes; a successful Forgejo abandonment fixture with affirmative policy, required reason Learning, and human review/abandon transition; false/missing/malformed/inaccessible policy fixtures proving zero reason-Learning, branch, or PR writes
